poitp.setupMode.name: Setup Mode (internal)
poitp.setupMode.hint: Internal Beneos content-preparation tool. When enabled, POI notes are automatically tagged with Beneos binding flags on canvas load, create, and update. Leave DISABLED unless you are preparing Beneos content for release.
poitp.config.isBeneosHint: Marks this note as a Beneos teleporter. The reference is kept even if the target scene is missing, so a precise install hint can be shown.
poitp.audit.title: POI Teleporter Audit
poitp.audit.hint: Scans all scenes for broken Point of Interest links and identifies missing releases.
poitp.audit.empty: No broken POIs found. Everything looks good!
poitp.audit.invalidTarget: POI has no valid target reference
poitp.audit.cacheTargetNameHint: If enabled, the audit tool stores the target's name in the note's flags to remember it even if the target journal is later deleted/missing.
poitp.backfill.title: Backfill Beneos Binding Flags
poitp.backfill.menuHint: Iterates every scene in the world and writes Beneos binding flags to each POI note whose linked journal matches the strict Beneos naming pattern. Internal content-preparation tool. Requires Setup Mode.
poitp.backfill.description: This tool walks every scene and every POI note in the world. For each note whose linked journal matches the strict Beneos naming pattern (DontTouch-POI-Teleporter-*), the Beneos binding flags are written or refreshed. Notes flagged as user-override are skipped.
poitp.backfill.needSetupMode: Setup Mode must be enabled (POI Teleporter settings) before running the backfill.
poitp.backfill.confirmBody: This will scan every scene in the world and write Beneos binding flags to every POI note whose target journal matches the strict Beneos naming pattern. This can touch a large number of notes and may take a while. Continue?
poitp.backfill.doneNotification: Backfill complete: {updated} notes updated across {scenes} scenes.
